name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - "pull-request/[0-9]+"
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        required: false
        type: string
      source-date-epoch:
        required: false
        type: string
      version:
        required: false
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.event_name }}"
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
  UV_LINK_MODE: copy

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}

jobs:
  pre-commit:
    name: Quality / pre-commit
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    steps:
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: >-
          uvx --from pre-commit==4.6.0 pre-commit run --all-files
          --show-diff-on-failure

  docs:
    name: Docs / Sphinx
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    steps:
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$RELEASE_VERSION" ]]; then
            printf 'SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=%s\n' \
              "$RELEASE_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          uv venv --python 3.12 .venv
          uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --requirement docs/requirements.txt
      - name: Build documentation
        run: >-
          .venv/bin/sphinx-build -b html -W --keep-going
          docs docs/_build/html
      - name: Check documentation links
        run: >-
          .venv/bin/sphinx-build -b linkcheck -W --keep-going
          docs docs/_build/linkcheck
      - name: Upload rendered documentation
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-docs
          path: docs/_build/html
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  sdist:
    name: Package / source distribution
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    steps:
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Build and validate source distribution
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: ${{ inputs.source-date-epoch }}
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          source_date_epoch="$RELEASE_SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
          if [[ -z "$source_date_epoch" ]]; then
            source_date_epoch="$(git show -s --format=%ct HEAD)"
          fi
          [[ "$source_date_epoch" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$source_date_epoch"
          if [[ -n "$RELEASE_VERSION" ]]; then
            export SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION"
          fi
          uv build --sdist --out-dir dist
          uvx --from twine==7.0.0 twine check --strict dist/*.tar.gz
      - name: Upload source distribution
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-sdist
          path: dist/*.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  wheels:
    name: Wheel / cu${{ matrix.cuda }} / ${{ matrix.arch }}
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    needs:
      - sdist
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - cuda: "12"
            arch: x86_64
            runner: linux-amd64-cpu8
            image: quay.io/manylinux_cuda/manylinux_2_28_x86_64_cuda12_2@sha256:ebab14ba10620bdb2451ee86c2445f455eee6e6373b31e713b5738e93f3b08b2
            architectures: "75-real;80-real;86-real;89-real;90"
          - cuda: "12"
            arch: aarch64
            runner: linux-arm64-cpu8
            image: quay.io/manylinux_cuda/manylinux_2_28_aarch64_cuda12_2@sha256:1d1af877622abef8d30b1c0718f36c1afc0299e1e98a114c06e3ff58dab4e222
            architectures: "75-real;80-real;86-real;89-real;90"
          - cuda: "13"
            arch: x86_64
            runner: linux-amd64-cpu8
            image: quay.io/manylinux_cuda/manylinux_2_28_x86_64_cuda13_0@sha256:f1a3dcd384bd8de50bfbeff92e75bf830ddcfe44897195d1a82c6ac162c8f36d
            architectures: "75-real;80-real;86-real;89-real;90-real;100-real;120"
          - cuda: "13"
            arch: aarch64
            runner: linux-arm64-cpu8
            image: quay.io/manylinux_cuda/manylinux_2_28_aarch64_cuda13_0@sha256:cdff0d2c97f15c17ac94106b292fd785a14fffae112831ecefd961ab2c22c837
            architectures: "75-real;80-real;86-real;89-real;90-real;100-real;120"
    env:
      CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX: ${{ matrix.arch }}
      CIBW_BUILD: cp312-manylinux_${{ matrix.arch }}
      CIBW_BUILD_VERBOSITY: "1"
      CIBW_ENVIRONMENT: >-
        CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
        PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH
      CIBW_SKIP: "*-musllinux*"
      CIBW_TEST_SKIP: "*"
      CIBW_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.image }}
      CUDA_ARCHITECTURES: ${{ matrix.architectures }}
      CUDA_MAJOR: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
      RELEASE_SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: ${{ inputs.source-date-epoch }}
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      WHEELHOUSE_DIR: wheelhouse-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
    steps:
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Download source distribution
        if: inputs.version != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-sdist
          path: source-dist
      - name: Prepare CUDA-specific wheel metadata
        run: |
          source_date_epoch="$RELEASE_SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
          if [[ -z "$source_date_epoch" ]]; then
            source_date_epoch="$(git show -s --format=%ct HEAD)"
          fi
          [[ "$source_date_epoch" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="$source_date_epoch"
          printf 'SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=%s\n' "$source_date_epoch" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          package_version="$RELEASE_VERSION"
          if [[ -z "$package_version" ]]; then
            package_version="$(
              uv run --isolated --no-project \
                --with hatch-vcs==0.5.0 --with hatchling \
                python -m hatchling version
            )"
          fi
          uv run --isolated --no-project --with tomlkit==0.15.1 \
            python ci/prepare_cuda_wheel.py \
            --cuda-major "$CUDA_MAJOR" \
            --architectures "$CUDA_ARCHITECTURES" \
            --version "$package_version"
          python3 -c "import tomllib; tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml', 'rb'))"
      - name: Select the pinned CUDA builder image
        run: |
          case "$CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX" in
            aarch64)
              printf 'CIBW_MANYLINUX_AARCH64_IMAGE=%s\n' "$CIBW_IMAGE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
              ;;
            x86_64)
              printf 'CIBW_MANYLINUX_X86_64_IMAGE=%s\n' "$CIBW_IMAGE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
              ;;
            *)
              printf 'Unsupported architecture: %s\n' "$CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
      - name: Build wheel from source distribution
        if: inputs.version != ''
        run: |
          mapfile -t sdists < <(
            find source-dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'cuspa-*.tar.gz' -print
          )
          [[ "${#sdists[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          sdist="source-dist/cuspa-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tar.gz"
          [[ "${sdists[0]}" == "$sdist" ]]
          digest="$(sha256sum "$sdist" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
          printf 'sdist sha256: %s\n' "$digest"
          CIBW_CONFIG_SETTINGS="cmake.define.CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=${CUDA_ARCHITECTURES}" \
            uvx --from cibuildwheel==3.4.1 cibuildwheel \
              --output-dir source-wheel "$sdist"
          [[ "$(sha256sum "$sdist" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$digest" ]]
          mapfile -t wheels < <(
            find source-wheel -maxdepth 1 -type f \
              -name "cuspa-${RELEASE_VERSION}-*.whl" -print
          )
          [[ "${#wheels[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          uvx --from twine==7.0.0 twine check --strict "${wheels[0]}"
      - name: Build wheel
        run: >-
          uvx --from cibuildwheel==3.4.1
          cibuildwheel --output-dir "$WHEELHOUSE_DIR" .
      - name: Validate wheel
        id: validate-wheel
        run: |
          mapfile -t wheels < <(
            find "$WHEELHOUSE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
              -name "cuspa_cu${CUDA_MAJOR}-*.whl" -print
          )
          if [[ "${#wheels[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
            printf 'Expected one wheel; found %s\n' "${#wheels[@]}" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "${wheels[@]}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          wheel="${wheels[0]}"
          uvx --from auditwheel==6.8.2 auditwheel show "$wheel"
          uvx --from abi3audit==0.0.26 abi3audit --strict "$wheel"
          uvx --from twine==7.0.0 twine check --strict "$wheel"
          printf 'wheel=%s\n' "$wheel" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Upload wheel
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: ${{ steps.validate-wheel.outputs.wheel }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  gpu-tests:
    name: GPU / cu${{ matrix.cuda }} / ${{ matrix.gpu }}
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    needs:
      - wheels
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - cuda: "12"
            gpu: t4
            runner: linux-amd64-gpu-t4-latest-1
            python: "3.12"
            expected_name: T4
            compute_capability: "7.5"
            container: nvidia/cuda:12.9.1-devel-ubuntu24.04@sha256:020bc241a628776338f4d4053fed4c38f6f7f3d7eb5919fecb8de313bb8ba47c
            coverage: ""
          - cuda: "12"
            gpu: h100
            runner: linux-amd64-gpu-h100-latest-1
            python: "3.13"
            expected_name: H100
            compute_capability: "9.0"
            container: nvidia/cuda:12.9.1-devel-ubuntu24.04@sha256:020bc241a628776338f4d4053fed4c38f6f7f3d7eb5919fecb8de313bb8ba47c
            coverage: ""
          - cuda: "13"
            gpu: blackwell
            runner: linux-amd64-gpu-rtxpro6000-latest-1
            python: "3.14"
            expected_name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell
            compute_capability: "12.0"
            container: nvidia/cuda:13.1.0-devel-ubuntu24.04@sha256:7f32ae6e575abb29f2dacf6c75fe94a262bb48dcc5196ac833ced59d9fde8107
            coverage: --cov=cuspa --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage-cu13-blackwell.xml
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.container }}
      options: -u root --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size 16g
      env:
        NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: ${{ env.NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES }}
    env:
      CUDA_MAJOR: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
      EXPECTED_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY: ${{ matrix.compute_capability }}
      EXPECTED_GPU_NAME: ${{ matrix.expected_name }}
      GPU_LABEL: ${{ matrix.gpu }}
      PYTEST_COVERAGE_ARGS: ${{ matrix.coverage }}
      PYTHON_VERSION: ${{ matrix.python }}
    steps:
      - name: Check GPU allocation
        run: nvidia-smi
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
        with:
          enable-apt: true
      - name: Install CI prerequisites
        run: |
          apt-get update
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install \
            --yes --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Download wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-x86_64
          path: wheelhouse-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-x86_64
      - name: Install wheel and test dependencies
        run: |
          environment=".wheel-venv-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}"
          uv venv --python "$PYTHON_VERSION" "$environment"
          uv pip install --python "$environment/bin/python" \
            "cupy-cuda${CUDA_MAJOR}x[ctk]>=14" \
            pytest pytest-cov pytest-timeout scipy
          mapfile -t wheels < <(
            find "wheelhouse-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}-x86_64" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
              -name "cuspa_cu${CUDA_MAJOR}-*.whl" -print
          )
          if [[ "${#wheels[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
            printf 'Expected one wheel; found %s\n' "${#wheels[@]}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          wheel="$(realpath "${wheels[0]}")"
          uv pip install --python "$environment/bin/python" --no-deps "$wheel"
          uv pip check --python "$environment/bin/python"
          "$environment/bin/python" -c \
            "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('cuspa-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}'))"
          "$environment/bin/python" -c "import cupy; cupy.show_config()"
      - name: Verify the GPU target
        run: |
          ".wheel-venv-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}/bin/python" ci/check_gpu_target.py \
            --name-contains "$EXPECTED_GPU_NAME" \
            --compute-capability "$EXPECTED_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY"
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          coverage_args=()
          if [[ -n "$PYTEST_COVERAGE_ARGS" ]]; then
            read -r -a coverage_args <<< "$PYTEST_COVERAGE_ARGS"
          fi
          ".wheel-venv-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}/bin/python" -m pytest -v \
            --junitxml="report-wheel-cu${CUDA_MAJOR}-${GPU_LABEL}.xml" \
            "${coverage_args[@]}"
      - name: Upload test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: test-results-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-${{ matrix.gpu }}
          path: |
            report-wheel-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-${{ matrix.gpu }}.xml
            coverage-cu${{ matrix.cuda }}-${{ matrix.gpu }}.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  required:
    name: CI / Required
    if: always()
    needs:
      - pre-commit
      - docs
      - sdist
      - wheels
      - gpu-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
    steps:
      - name: Require expected job results
        run: |
          check_result() {
            local job="$1"
            local expected="$2"
            local actual
            actual="$(jq -r --arg job "$job" '.[$job].result' <<< "$NEEDS_JSON")"
            printf '%s: %s (expected %s)\n' "$job" "$actual" "$expected"
            [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]
          }

          status=0
          check_result pre-commit success || status=1
          check_result docs success || status=1
          check_result sdist success || status=1
          check_result wheels success || status=1

          check_result gpu-tests success || status=1

          exit "$status"

# Installation

## Requirements

cuspa requires Python 3.12 or newer, a compatible NVIDIA GPU and driver, a CUDA
12 or CUDA 13 runtime, and CuPy or CUDA-enabled PyTorch. Aggregation and I/O
adapters currently require CuPy.

Source builds also require a matching CUDA toolkit that supports the target GPU
and a C++17 compiler. Install the CuPy or PyTorch package matching your CUDA
environment separately.

## Source install

```bash
python -m pip install .
```

Source installs compile for the GPU detected on the build machine.

## Release wheels

When published to PyPI, install the distribution matching your CUDA major:

```bash
python -m pip install cuspa-cu12  # CUDA 12
python -m pip install cuspa-cu13  # CUDA 13
```

Install only one. Both distributions provide the `cuspa` Python package.
Wheels target manylinux_2_28 on x86_64 and aarch64. CUDA 12 wheels target SM
75, 80, 86, 89, and 90; CUDA 13 wheels also target SM 100 and 120.

Verify the installation on a GPU host:

```bash
python -c 'import cuspa, cuspa._core; print(cuspa.__version__)'
```

## Development install

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[test]"
```

## Optional adapters

From a source checkout:

```bash
python -m pip install ".[geoarrow]"
python -m pip install ".[geopandas]"
python -m pip install ".[spatialdata]"
```

For a wheel, replace `.` with `cuspa-cu12` or `cuspa-cu13`.

name: DCO

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}

jobs:
  signed-off-commits:
    name: DCO / Signed-off commits
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify commit sign-offs
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          HEAD_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
          PR_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$PR_AUTHOR" == 'dependabot[bot]' && \
                "$HEAD_REPOSITORY" == "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" ]]; then
            echo 'Trusted in-repository Dependabot update; DCO trailer is exempt.'
            exit 0
          fi

          status=0
          while read -r commit; do
            author="$(git show --no-patch --format='%an <%ae>' "$commit")"
            signed_off=false
            while IFS=: read -r key value; do
              value="${value# }"
              if [[ "${key,,}" == signed-off-by && "${value,,}" == "${author,,}" ]]; then
                signed_off=true
                break
              fi
            done < <(
              git show --no-patch --format=%B "$commit" |
                git interpret-trailers --parse
            )
            if [[ "$signed_off" != true ]]; then
              printf 'Missing author sign-off: %s (%s)\n' "$commit" "$author" >&2
              status=1
            fi
          done < <(git rev-list "$BASE_SHA..$HEAD_SHA")
          exit "$status"

name: Publish Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Release tag staged in Artifactory
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: "publish-release-${{ inputs.tag }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}

jobs:
  release:
    name: Publish / Validate release
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    outputs:
      prerelease: ${{ steps.release.outputs.prerelease }}
      sha: ${{ steps.release.outputs.sha }}
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      version: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out the release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ inputs.tag }}
      - name: Validate the release tag
        id: release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/heads/main ]]
          [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(rc[0-9]+)?$ ]]
          version="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          prerelease=false
          if [[ "$version" == *rc* ]]; then
            prerelease=true
          fi

          sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          [[ "$sha" == "$(git rev-list -n 1 "$RELEASE_TAG")" ]]
          [[ "$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${RELEASE_TAG}" --jq .sha
          )" == "$sha" ]]
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$sha" refs/remotes/origin/main

          {
            printf 'prerelease=%s\n' "$prerelease"
            printf 'sha=%s\n' "$sha"
            printf 'tag=%s\n' "$RELEASE_TAG"
            printf 'version=%s\n' "$version"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  verify:
    name: Publish / Verify nSpect approval
    needs:
      - release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    environment: release-staging
    outputs:
      artifact-name: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.artifact-name }}
      sha: ${{ needs.release.outputs.sha }}
      source-base: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.source-base }}
      tag: ${{ needs.release.outputs.tag }}
      version: ${{ needs.release.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      ARTIFACTORY_OIDC_PROVIDER: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTORY_OIDC_PROVIDER }}
      ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY }}
      ARTIFACTORY_URL: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTORY_URL }}
      NSPECT_FINAL_TYPE: ${{ vars.NSPECT_FINAL_TYPE }}
      NSPECT_ID: ${{ vars.NSPECT_ID }}
      NSPECT_PRERELEASE_TYPE: ${{ vars.NSPECT_PRERELEASE_TYPE }}
      RELEASE_IS_PRERELEASE: ${{ needs.release.outputs.prerelease }}
      RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.release.outputs.sha }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.release.outputs.tag }}
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.release.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Validate Artifactory configuration
        run: |
          [[ -n "$ARTIFACTORY_OIDC_PROVIDER" ]]
          [[ "$ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY" == sw-cuspa-generic-local ]]
          [[ "${ARTIFACTORY_URL%/}" == https://artifactory.nvidia.com ]]
          [[ "$NSPECT_ID" =~ ^NSPECT-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ ]]
      - name: Authenticate to Artifactory
        run: |
          oidc_token="$(
            curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}" \
              "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL" |
              jq -er '.value | strings | select(length > 0)'
          )"
          printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$oidc_token"
          exchange_body="$(
            jq -nc \
              --arg provider "$ARTIFACTORY_OIDC_PROVIDER" \
              --arg token "$oidc_token" '
                {
                  grant_type:
                    "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange",
                  subject_token_type:
                    "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token",
                  subject_token: $token,
                  provider_name: $provider
                }
              '
          )"
          artifactory_token="$(
            curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              --data "$exchange_body" \
              "${ARTIFACTORY_URL%/}/access/api/v1/oidc/token" |
              jq -er '.access_token | strings | select(length > 0)'
          )"
          printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$artifactory_token"
          printf 'ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN=%s\n' "$artifactory_token" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download and verify the staged bundle
        id: bundle
        run: |
          artifactory_path="cuspa/nspect/${NSPECT_ID}/${RELEASE_TAG}/${RELEASE_SHA}"
          artifactory_base="${ARTIFACTORY_URL%/}/artifactory/${ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY}/${artifactory_path}"
          auth_header="Authorization: Bearer ${ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN}"
          mkdir release-dist

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --location \
            --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
            --max-time 120 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
            -H "$auth_header" -o release-dist/manifest.json \
            "${artifactory_base}/manifest.json"

          jq -e \
            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" \
            --arg commit "$RELEASE_SHA" '
              .schemaVersion == 1 and
              .repository == $repository and
              .tag == $tag and
              .version == $version and
              .commit == $commit and
              (.artifacts | length) == 5 and
              ([.artifacts[].name] | unique | length) == 5
            ' release-dist/manifest.json > /dev/null

          expected_sums="${RUNNER_TEMP}/SHA256SUMS"
          : > "$expected_sums"
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r name size digest source_pointer; do
            [[ "$name" == "$(basename "$name")" ]]
            [[ "$name" =~ ^cuspa(_cu(12|13))?-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+.*(\.whl|\.tar\.gz)$ ]]
            [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
            [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
            expected_pointer="${artifactory_base}/${name}"
            [[ "$source_pointer" == "$expected_pointer" ]]

            curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --location \
              --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
              --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
              -H "$auth_header" -o "release-dist/${name}" "$source_pointer"
            [[ "$(stat -c %s "release-dist/${name}")" == "$size" ]]
            [[ "$(
              sha256sum "release-dist/${name}" | cut -d ' ' -f 1
            )" == "$digest" ]]
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" >> "$expected_sums"
          done < <(
            jq -r '.artifacts[] | [.name, .size, .sha256, .sourcePointer] | @tsv' \
              release-dist/manifest.json
          )

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --location \
            --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
            --max-time 120 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
            -H "$auth_header" -o release-dist/SHA256SUMS \
            "${artifactory_base}/SHA256SUMS"
          cmp "$expected_sums" release-dist/SHA256SUMS
          [[ "$(find release-dist -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 7 ]]

          mapfile -t wheels < <(compgen -G 'release-dist/*.whl')
          mapfile -t sdists < <(compgen -G 'release-dist/*.tar.gz')
          [[ "${#wheels[@]}" -eq 4 ]]
          [[ "${#sdists[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          [[ -f "release-dist/cuspa-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tar.gz" ]]
          for cuda in 12 13; do
            for arch in x86_64 aarch64; do
              mapfile -t matches < <(
                compgen -G \
                  "release-dist/cuspa_cu${cuda}-${RELEASE_VERSION}-*_${arch}.whl"
              )
              [[ "${#matches[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
            done
          done

          uvx --from twine==7.0.0 twine check --strict \
            release-dist/*.whl release-dist/*.tar.gz
          for wheel in "${wheels[@]}"; do
            uvx --from abi3audit==0.0.26 abi3audit --strict "$wheel"
          done

          artifact_name="cuspa-release-${RELEASE_TAG}"
          printf 'artifact-name=%s\n' "$artifact_name" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'source-base=%s\n' "$artifactory_base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Require nSpect launch readiness
        env:
          NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID }}
          NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        run: |
          for value in \
            NSPECT_FINAL_TYPE NSPECT_ID NSPECT_PRERELEASE_TYPE \
            NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET; do
            [[ -n "${!value}" ]]
          done
          if [[ "$RELEASE_IS_PRERELEASE" == true ]]; then
            release_type="$NSPECT_PRERELEASE_TYPE"
          else
            [[ "$RELEASE_IS_PRERELEASE" == false ]]
            release_type="$NSPECT_FINAL_TYPE"
          fi

          basic_auth="$(
            printf '%s' "${NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID}:${NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET}" |
              base64 | tr -d '\n'
          )"
          nspect_token="$(
            curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
              -H "Authorization: Basic ${basic_auth}" \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
              --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' \
              --data-urlencode 'scope=public.api:read public.api:write' \
              'https://4ubglassowmtsi7ogqwarmut7msn1q5ynts62fwnr1i.ssa.nvidia.com/token' |
              jq -er '.access_token | select(length > 0)'
          )"
          printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$nspect_token"
          auth_header="Authorization: Bearer ${nspect_token}"
          release_url="https://nspect.nvidia.com/api/v2/public/programs/${NSPECT_ID}/releases/${RELEASE_TAG}"
          response="${RUNNER_TEMP}/nspect-response.json"

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error -H "$auth_header" \
            "${release_url}/binary-artifacts?pageSize=1000" > "$response"
          jq -e --slurpfile manifest release-dist/manifest.json '
            ($manifest[0].artifacts | map(.sourcePointer) | sort) as $expected |
            (.page.total <= 1000) and
            ([.data.binaryArtifacts[].sourcePointer] | sort) == $expected and
            ([.data.binaryArtifacts[] | select(.includedInRelease != true)] |
              length == 0)
          ' "$response" > /dev/null

          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error -H "$auth_header" \
            "${release_url}/release-types?pageSize=1000" > "$response"
          jq -e \
            '.page.total == 1 and (.data.releaseTypes | length) == 1' \
            "$response" > /dev/null
          mapfile -t selected_types < <(
            jq -er '.data.releaseTypes[] | select(.regulation == null) | .name' \
              "$response"
          )
          [[ "${#selected_types[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          [[ "${selected_types[0]}" == "$release_type" ]]

          encoded_type="$(jq -rn --arg value "$release_type" '$value | @uri')"
          launch_url="https://nspect.nvidia.com/api/v2/launch/programs/${NSPECT_ID}/releases/${RELEASE_TAG}?releaseType=${encoded_type}"
          completed=false
          for attempt in {1..20}; do
            headers="${RUNNER_TEMP}/nspect-headers"
            status="$(
              curl --silent --show-error -D "$headers" -H "$auth_header" \
                -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' "$launch_url"
            )"
            case "$status" in
              200)
                if ! jq -e \
                  --arg id "$NSPECT_ID" --arg release "$RELEASE_TAG" '
                    .success == true and
                    .data.nspectId == $id and
                    .data.releaseVersion == $release and
                    .data.launchResult == "pass" and
                    (.data.partial // false) == false
                  ' "$response" > /dev/null; then
                  jq . "$response" >&2
                  exit 1
                fi
                completed=true
                break
                ;;
              429)
                retry_after="$(
                  awk 'tolower($1) == "retry-after:" {gsub("\\r", "", $2); print $2}' \
                    "$headers"
                )"
                [[ "$retry_after" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
                [[ "$retry_after" -le 60 ]]
                sleep "$retry_after"
                ;;
              500|504)
                sleep "$((attempt < 6 ? attempt * 5 : 30))"
                ;;
              *)
                printf 'nSpect Launch returned HTTP %s.\n' "$status" >&2
                jq . "$response" >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          done
          [[ "$completed" == true ]]
      - name: Save the approved bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: release-dist
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  kitmaker-validate:
    name: Publish / Kitmaker check / ${{ matrix.project }}
    needs:
      - verify
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 100
    environment: release-staging
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - project: cuspa
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA }}
            pattern: ^cuspa-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+\.tar\.gz$
            count: 1
          - project: cuspa-cu12
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA_CU12 }}
            pattern: ^cuspa_cu12-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+-.*\.whl$
            count: 2
          - project: cuspa-cu13
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA_CU13 }}
            pattern: ^cuspa_cu13-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+-.*\.whl$
            count: 2
    steps:
      - name: Check out the release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.tag }}
      - name: Download the verified bundle
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: release-dist
      - name: Install Teleport
        uses: teleport-actions/setup@b638ff596557cc3959eb6b5287d5e58e0c8ac6a6 # v1.1.1
        with:
          version: auto
          proxy: ext-nv-prd-apps.teleport.sh:443
      - name: Connect to Kitmaker through Charon
        uses: teleport-actions/application-tunnel@bb7a8fbfb67b85d26013554f10d71dd032c1c764 # v1.0.1
        with:
          proxy: ext-nv-prd-apps.teleport.sh:443
          token: charon-gha-runners
          app: charon
          listen: tcp://127.0.0.1:8888
      - name: Validate with Kitmaker
        env:
          CHARON_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8888
          EXPECTED_COUNT: ${{ matrix.count }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          KITMAKER_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.KITMAKER_PORTAL_AUTHORIZATION }}
          KITMAKER_PIC_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.KITMAKER_PORTAL_ACC_OWNER_EMAIL }}
          PROJECT_ID: ${{ matrix.project-id }}
          PROJECT_NAME: ${{ matrix.project }}
          PROJECT_PATTERN: ${{ matrix.pattern }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.sha }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.tag }}
          SOURCE_BASE: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.source-base }}
        run: |
          [[ "$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${RELEASE_TAG}" --jq .sha
          )" == "$RELEASE_SHA" ]]
          bash --noprofile --norc ci/kitmaker_release.sh \
            false "$PROJECT_ID" "$PROJECT_NAME" "$KITMAKER_PIC_EMAIL" \
            "$PROJECT_PATTERN" "$EXPECTED_COUNT" release-dist/manifest.json

  kitmaker-publish:
    name: Publish / Kitmaker / ${{ matrix.project }}
    needs:
      - verify
      - kitmaker-validate
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 110
    environment: publish
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - project: cuspa
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA }}
            pattern: ^cuspa-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+\.tar\.gz$
            count: 1
          - project: cuspa-cu12
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA_CU12 }}
            pattern: ^cuspa_cu12-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+-.*\.whl$
            count: 2
          - project: cuspa-cu13
            project-id: ${{ vars.KITMAKER_PROJECT_ID_CUSPA_CU13 }}
            pattern: ^cuspa_cu13-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+-.*\.whl$
            count: 2
    steps:
      - name: Check out the release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.tag }}
      - name: Download the verified bundle
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: release-dist
      - name: Install Teleport
        uses: teleport-actions/setup@b638ff596557cc3959eb6b5287d5e58e0c8ac6a6 # v1.1.1
        with:
          version: auto
          proxy: ext-nv-prd-apps.teleport.sh:443
      - name: Connect to Kitmaker through Charon
        uses: teleport-actions/application-tunnel@bb7a8fbfb67b85d26013554f10d71dd032c1c764 # v1.0.1
        with:
          proxy: ext-nv-prd-apps.teleport.sh:443
          token: charon-gha-runners
          app: charon
          listen: tcp://127.0.0.1:8888
      - name: Publish with Kitmaker
        env:
          CHARON_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8888
          EXPECTED_COUNT: ${{ matrix.count }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          KITMAKER_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.KITMAKER_PORTAL_AUTHORIZATION }}
          KITMAKER_PIC_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.KITMAKER_PORTAL_ACC_OWNER_EMAIL }}
          PROJECT_ID: ${{ matrix.project-id }}
          PROJECT_NAME: ${{ matrix.project }}
          PROJECT_PATTERN: ${{ matrix.pattern }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.sha }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.tag }}
          SOURCE_BASE: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.source-base }}
        run: |
          [[ "$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${RELEASE_TAG}" --jq .sha
          )" == "$RELEASE_SHA" ]]
          bash --noprofile --norc ci/kitmaker_release.sh \
            true "$PROJECT_ID" "$PROJECT_NAME" "$KITMAKER_PIC_EMAIL" \
            "$PROJECT_PATTERN" "$EXPECTED_COUNT" release-dist/manifest.json

  github:
    name: Publish / GitHub release
    needs:
      - verify
      - kitmaker-publish
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download the approved bundle
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.artifact-name }}
          path: release-dist
      - name: Create and verify the immutable release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.sha }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          mapfile -t files < <(
            find release-dist -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name manifest.json -print |
              sort
          )
          files+=(release-dist/manifest.json)
          [[ "${#files[@]}" -eq 7 ]]

          declare -A local_digests
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            name="$(basename "$file")"
            local_digests["$name"]="sha256:$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
          done
          [[ "${#local_digests[@]}" -eq 7 ]]

          expected_prerelease=false
          prerelease_arg=()
          if [[ "$RELEASE_VERSION" == *rc* ]]; then
            expected_prerelease=true
            prerelease_arg=(--prerelease)
          fi

          verify_release() {
            local release_json="$1"
            local asset
            local name
            local digest
            declare -A seen=()

            jq -e --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --argjson prerelease "$expected_prerelease" '
                .draft == false and .immutable == true and
                .tag_name == $tag and .prerelease == $prerelease and
                (.assets | length) == 7 and
                ([.assets[].state] | all(. == "uploaded"))
              ' <<< "$release_json" > /dev/null || return 1
            while IFS= read -r asset; do
              IFS=$'\t' read -r name digest <<< "$asset"
              [[ -v "local_digests[$name]" ]] || return 1
              [[ ! -v "seen[$name]" ]] || return 1
              [[ "$digest" == "${local_digests[$name]}" ]] || return 1
              seen["$name"]=1
            done < <(
              jq -r '.assets[] | [.name, (.digest // "")] | @tsv' \
                <<< "$release_json"
            )
            [[ "${#seen[@]}" -eq 7 ]]
          }

          tag_ref_before="$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" \
              --jq '[.object.type, .object.sha] | @tsv'
          )"
          [[ "$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${RELEASE_TAG}" --jq .sha
          )" == "$RELEASE_SHA" ]]

          api_error="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-api-error"
          if release_json="$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" \
              2> "$api_error"
          )"; then
            verify_release "$release_json"
          else
            grep -Fq '(HTTP 404)' "$api_error" || {
              cat "$api_error" >&2
              exit 1
            }
            create_status=0
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" "${files[@]}" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --verify-tag \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" --generate-notes \
              "${prerelease_arg[@]}" || create_status=$?
            if [[ "$create_status" -ne 0 ]]; then
              release_json="$(
                gh api \
                  "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}"
              )" || exit "$create_status"
              verify_release "$release_json" || exit "$create_status"
            fi
          fi

          verified=false
          for _ in {1..12}; do
            release_json="$(
              gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}"
            )"
            if verify_release "$release_json"; then
              verified=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          [[ "$verified" == true ]]

          tag_ref_after="$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" \
              --jq '[.object.type, .object.sha] | @tsv'
          )"
          [[ "$tag_ref_after" == "$tag_ref_before" ]]
          [[ "$(
            gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${RELEASE_TAG}" --jq .sha
          )" == "$RELEASE_SHA" ]]
          {
            printf '### Release complete\n\n'
            printf 'Kitmaker published all five packages and GitHub release %s is immutable.\n' \
              "$RELEASE_TAG"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Prepare Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

concurrency:
  group: "prepare-release-${{ github.ref_name }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash --noprofile --norc -euo pipefail {0}

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Release / Validate
    if: github.repository == 'NVIDIA/cuspa'
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    outputs:
      prerelease: ${{ steps.release.outputs.prerelease }}
      release-date: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release-date }}
      sha: ${{ steps.release.outputs.sha }}
      source-date-epoch: ${{ steps.release.outputs.source-date-epoch }}
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      version: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Use NVIDIA package cache
        uses: nv-gha-runners/setup-proxy-cache@14229018fe157c83e03c008f27d183d8e99bc67c # main
      - name: Check out the release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Validate the release
        id: release
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" ]]
          [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(rc[0-9]+)?$ ]]
          version="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"

          sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          [[ "$sha" == "$(git rev-list -n 1 "$RELEASE_TAG")" ]]
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$sha" refs/remotes/origin/main
          source_date_epoch="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$sha")"
          [[ "$source_date_epoch" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]

          package_version="$(
            uv run --isolated --no-project \
              --with hatch-vcs==0.5.0 --with hatchling \
              python -m hatchling version
          )"
          [[ "$package_version" == "$version" ]]

          prerelease=false
          if [[ "$version" == *rc* ]]; then
            prerelease=true
          fi
          release_date="$(date -u -d "@${source_date_epoch}" +%F)"

          {
            printf 'prerelease=%s\n' "$prerelease"
            printf 'release-date=%s\n' "$release_date"
            printf 'sha=%s\n' "$sha"
            printf 'source-date-epoch=%s\n' "$source_date_epoch"
            printf 'tag=%s\n' "$RELEASE_TAG"
            printf 'version=%s\n' "$version"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  packages:
    name: Release / Build and test
    needs:
      - validate
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.sha }}
      source-date-epoch: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.source-date-epoch }}
      version: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.version }}

  bundle:
    name: Release / Bundle
    needs:
      - validate
      - packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    # Supplies NSPECT_ID for the staging path; this job uses no secrets.
    environment: release-staging
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY }}
      ARTIFACTORY_URL: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTORY_URL }}
      NSPECT_ID: ${{ vars.NSPECT_ID }}
      RELEASE_SHA: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.sha }}
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Download wheels
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: cuspa-cu*
          path: release-dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Download source distribution
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-sdist
          path: release-dist
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@fac544c07dec837d0ccb6301d7b5580bf5edae39 # v8.2.0
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          version: "0.9.25"
      - name: Validate and describe the release bundle
        run: |
          [[ "$ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY" == sw-cuspa-generic-local ]]
          [[ "${ARTIFACTORY_URL%/}" == https://artifactory.nvidia.com ]]
          [[ "$NSPECT_ID" =~ ^NSPECT-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ ]]

          mapfile -t wheels < <(compgen -G 'release-dist/*.whl')
          mapfile -t sdists < <(compgen -G 'release-dist/*.tar.gz')
          [[ "${#wheels[@]}" -eq 4 ]]
          [[ "${#sdists[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          [[ -f "release-dist/cuspa-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tar.gz" ]]
          for cuda in 12 13; do
            for arch in x86_64 aarch64; do
              mapfile -t matches < <(
                compgen -G \
                  "release-dist/cuspa_cu${cuda}-${RELEASE_VERSION}-*_${arch}.whl"
              )
              [[ "${#matches[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
            done
          done

          uvx --from twine==7.0.0 twine check --strict release-dist/*
          for wheel in "${wheels[@]}"; do
            uvx --from abi3audit==0.0.26 abi3audit --strict "$wheel"
          done

          # ci/stage_release.sh uploads the bundle to these Artifactory paths.
          artifactory_path="cuspa/nspect/${NSPECT_ID}/${RELEASE_TAG}/${RELEASE_SHA}"
          artifactory_base="${ARTIFACTORY_URL%/}"

          mapfile -t packages < <(
            find release-dist -maxdepth 1 -type f \
              \( -name '*.whl' -o -name '*.tar.gz' \) -print | sort
          )
          artifacts='[]'
          : > release-dist/SHA256SUMS
          for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
            name="$(basename "$package")"
            digest="$(sha256sum "$package" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
            size="$(stat -c %s "$package")"
            source_pointer="${artifactory_base}/artifactory/${ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY}/${artifactory_path}/${name}"
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" >> release-dist/SHA256SUMS
            artifacts="$(
              jq -c \
                --arg name "$name" \
                --arg sha256 "$digest" \
                --arg sourcePointer "$source_pointer" \
                --argjson size "$size" \
                '. + [{name: $name, size: $size, sha256: $sha256, sourcePointer: $sourcePointer}]' \
                <<< "$artifacts"
            )"
          done
          [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$artifacts")" -eq 5 ]]
          jq -n \
            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" \
            --arg commit "$RELEASE_SHA" \
            --argjson artifacts "$artifacts" \
            '{schemaVersion: 1, repository: $repository, tag: $tag, version: $version, commit: $commit, artifacts: $artifacts}' \
            > release-dist/manifest.json
          [[ "$(find release-dist -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 7 ]]
      - name: Save the release bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: cuspa-release-${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
          path: release-dist
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
      - name: Describe the next step
        run: |
          {
            printf '### Release bundle ready\n\n'
            printf 'On the NVIDIA network, stage it in Artifactory and register it with nSpect:\n\n'
            printf '    ci/stage_release.sh stage %s\n' "$RELEASE_TAG"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

[build-system]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"
requires = [
  "hatchling",
  "hatch-vcs>=0.5",
  "nanobind>=2.2.0",
  "scikit-build-core[hatchling]>=1.0.1",
]

[project]
name = "cuspa"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "GPU spatial operations for spatial-omics workloads."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
authors = [{ name = "NVIDIA Corporation" }]
license = "Apache-2.0"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
classifiers = [
  "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
  "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: GIS",
  "Environment :: GPU :: NVIDIA CUDA",
]
# Install the GPU array library separately to match the target CUDA runtime.
dependencies = ["numpy>=1.23"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
docs = [
  "hatch-vcs>=0.5",
  "hatchling",
  "myst-parser>=2",
  "nvidia-sphinx-theme==0.0.9.post1",
  "numpydoc>=1.8",
  "pydata-sphinx-theme>=0.16,<0.17",
  "sphinx>=8.1",
  "sphinx-copybutton",
  "sphinx-design",
]
geoarrow = ["pyarrow>=14"]
geopandas = ["geopandas>=1.0", "pyarrow>=14"]
spatialdata = [
  "spatialdata>=0.2",
  "geopandas>=1.0",
  "pyarrow>=14",
  "shapely>=2.0",
]
test = ["pytest>=8", "pytest-timeout>=2.3", "scipy>=1.13"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuspa"
Issues = "https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuspa/issues"
Repository = "https://github.com/NVIDIA/cuspa"

[tool.hatch.version]
source = "vcs"

[tool.hatch.version.raw-options]
version_scheme = "guess-next-dev"
local_scheme = "node-and-date"

[tool.hatch.build.hooks.vcs]
version-file = "python/cuspa/_version.py"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
# Hatchling packages the Python sources; its scikit-build hook installs _core.
packages = ["python/cuspa"]
exclude = ["**/*.cu", "**/*.cuh", "**/*.h"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.hooks.scikit-build]

[tool.scikit-build]
build-dir = "build/{wheel_tag}"
cmake.version = ">=3.26"
cmake.build-type = "Release"
ninja.version = ">=1.10"
wheel.py-api = "cp312"
# Source builds use the local GPU; CI rewrites this value before each wheel build.
cmake.define.CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES = "native"

# Keep CUDA runtime libraries outside the wheel, as CuPy supplies the matching
# runtime in the supported GPU environments.
[tool.cibuildwheel]
build = ["cp312-manylinux_x86_64", "cp312-manylinux_aarch64"]
skip = ["*-musllinux*"]
linux.repair-wheel-command = [
  "auditwheel repair --exclude 'libcudart.so.*' -w {dest_dir} {wheel}",
  "pipx run abi3audit --strict --report {wheel}",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = [
  "--import-mode=importlib",
  "--strict-config",
  "--strict-markers",
  "--timeout=60",
]

[tool.ruff]
src = ["python"]
line-length = 88
lint.select = [
  "F",       # Pyflakes
  "E",       # pycodestyle errors
  "W",       # pycodestyle warnings
  "I",       # isort
  "TID",     # flake8-tidy-imports
  "C4",      # flake8-comprehensions
  "BLE",     # flake8-blind-except
  "FBT",     # no boolean positional parameters
  "UP",      # pyupgrade
  "TID251",  # banned imports
  "RUF100",  # report unused noqa
  "ICN",     # follow import conventions
  "PTH",     # pathlib > os.path
  "TC",      # manage type-checking blocks
  "PLR0917", # ban APIs with too many positional parameters
]
lint.ignore = [
  "E501",   # long lines — comments can be long; code handled by formatter
  "E731",   # lambda assignment
  "E741",   # ambiguous variable names (I, O, l)
  "F403",   # missing docstring in public package
  "TID252", # relative imports from parent modules — fine inside a package
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"docs/*" = ["I"]
# Tests import CuPy after importorskip; API docstring and signature rules do not
# apply to test helpers.
"tests/*" = ["D", "E402", "FBT", "PLR0917"]
"benchmarks/*" = ["D", "FBT", "PLR0917"]
"*/__init__.py" = ["F401"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["cuspa"]
required-imports = ["from __future__ import annotations"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-import-conventions.extend-aliases]
geopandas = "gpd"

[tool.codespell]
skip = "build,data,.git,*.lock,*.parquet,*.zarr,*.zip"
ignore-words-list = "nd,arange"

"""Validate that a GPU CI job received its requested accelerator."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping


def validate_device(
    properties: Mapping[str, object],
    compute_capability: object,
    *,
    name_contains: str,
    expected_compute_capability: str,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Validate and return the normalized CUDA device name and capability."""
    raw_name = properties["name"]
    name = raw_name.decode() if isinstance(raw_name, bytes) else str(raw_name)
    actual = str(compute_capability).replace(".", "")
    expected = expected_compute_capability.replace(".", "")

    if name_contains.casefold() not in name.casefold():
        raise ValueError(
            f"expected GPU name containing {name_contains!r}, found {name!r}"
        )
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError(
            f"expected compute capability {expected_compute_capability}, "
            f"found {compute_capability}"
        )
    return name, actual


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--name-contains", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--compute-capability", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    import cupy as cp

    name, capability = validate_device(
        cp.cuda.runtime.getDeviceProperties(0),
        cp.cuda.Device(0).compute_capability,
        name_contains=args.name_contains,
        expected_compute_capability=args.compute_capability,
    )
    print(f"validated GPU: {name} (compute capability {capability})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

set -euo pipefail

upload="${1:?upload is required}"
project_id="${2:?project ID is required}"
project_name="${3:?project name is required}"
pic="${4:?project owner email is required}"
pattern="${5:?artifact pattern is required}"
expected_count="${6:?artifact count is required}"
manifest="${7:?manifest is required}"

: "${KITMAKER_API_TOKEN:?KITMAKER_API_TOKEN is required}"
: "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN:?GitHub OIDC permission is required}"
: "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL:?GitHub OIDC permission is required}"
: "${RELEASE_SHA:?release SHA is required}"
: "${RELEASE_TAG:?release tag is required}"
: "${SOURCE_BASE:?Artifactory source base is required}"
CHARON_URL="${CHARON_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8888}"
[[ "$upload" == true || "$upload" == false ]]
[[ "$project_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
[[ "$expected_count" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
[[ -f "$manifest" ]]

portal="${CHARON_URL%/}/kitmaker-portal/api/v0"
tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp_dir"' EXIT
printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$KITMAKER_API_TOKEN"

charon_token=""
charon_token_time=0
portal_http_code=""

refresh_charon_token() {
  local now
  local oidc_url
  local response

  now="$(date +%s)"
  if [[ -n "$charon_token" ]] && ((now - charon_token_time < 240)); then
    return
  fi
  oidc_url="$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL"
  if [[ "$oidc_url" == *\?* ]]; then
    oidc_url+='&audience=charon.nvidia.com'
  else
    oidc_url+='?audience=charon.nvidia.com'
  fi
  response="$(
    curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
      --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}" \
      "$oidc_url"
  )" || return
  charon_token="$(
    jq -er '.value | strings | select(length > 0)' <<< "$response"
  )" || return
  printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$charon_token" >&2
  charon_token_time="$now"
}

portal_request() {
  local method="$1"
  local path="$2"
  local output="$3"
  local body="${4:-}"
  local -a args=(
    --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120
    -X "$method"
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KITMAKER_API_TOKEN}"
    -o "$output" -w '%{http_code}'
  )

  portal_http_code=""
  refresh_charon_token || return
  args+=(-H "X-Charon-GHA-Token: ${charon_token}")
  if [[ -n "$body" ]]; then
    args+=(-H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$body")
  fi
  portal_http_code="$(curl "${args[@]}" "${portal}/${path}")"
}

mapfile -t artifacts < <(
  jq -r --arg pattern "$pattern" '
    .artifacts[] |
    select(.name | test($pattern)) |
    [.name, .sourcePointer, .sha256] | @tsv
  ' "$manifest"
)
[[ "${#artifacts[@]}" -eq "$expected_count" ]]
repository="$(jq -er '.repository | strings | select(length > 0)' "$manifest")"
tag="$(jq -er '.tag | strings | select(length > 0)' "$manifest")"
commit="$(jq -er '.commit | strings | select(length > 0)' "$manifest")"
[[ "$repository" == NVIDIA/cuspa ]]
[[ "$tag" == "$RELEASE_TAG" ]]
[[ "$commit" == "$RELEASE_SHA" ]]
source_prefix="https://artifactory.nvidia.com/artifactory/sw-cuspa-generic-local/cuspa/nspect/"
[[ "$SOURCE_BASE" == "${source_prefix}"*"/${tag}/${commit}" ]]
nspect_id="${SOURCE_BASE#${source_prefix}}"
nspect_id="${nspect_id%%/*}"
[[ "$nspect_id" =~ ^NSPECT-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ ]]
[[ "$SOURCE_BASE" == "${source_prefix}${nspect_id}/${tag}/${commit}" ]]

fetch_index() {
  local url="$1"
  local output="$2"
  local status

  status="$(
    curl --silent --show-error --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
      --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
      -H 'Accept: application/vnd.pypi.simple.v1+json' \
      -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' \
      -o "$output" -w '%{http_code}' "$url"
  )"
  [[ "$status" == 200 || "$status" == 404 ]]
  printf '%s' "$status"
}

load_indexes() {
  pypi_status="$(
    fetch_index "https://pypi.org/simple/${project_name}/" "$tmp_dir/pypi"
  )"
  devzone_status="$(
    fetch_index "https://pypi.nvidia.com/${project_name}/" "$tmp_dir/devzone"
  )"
}

pypi_digest() {
  local name="$1"
  if [[ "$pypi_status" == 404 ]]; then
    return
  fi
  jq -er --arg name "$name" '
    [.files[] | select(.filename == $name) | .hashes.sha256] | unique |
    if length == 0 then ""
    elif length == 1 then .[0]
    else error("duplicate filename")
    end
  ' "$tmp_dir/pypi"
}

devzone_digest() {
  local name="$1"
  local digest=""
  local href
  local candidate

  if [[ "$devzone_status" == 404 ]]; then
    return
  fi
  while IFS= read -r href; do
    href="${href#href=\"}"
    href="${href%\"}"
    if [[ "$href" == "${name}#sha256="* ]]; then
      candidate="${href#*#sha256=}"
      [[ "$candidate" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
      if [[ -n "$digest" && "$digest" != "$candidate" ]]; then
        printf 'Multiple hashes found for %s on pypi.nvidia.com.\n' "$name" >&2
        return 1
      fi
      digest="$candidate"
    fi
  done < <(grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' "$tmp_dir/devzone" || true)
  printf '%s' "$digest"
}

select_missing() {
  local allow_partial="${1:-false}"
  missing=()
  load_indexes
  local artifact
  local name
  local url
  local expected
  local public
  local devzone

  for artifact in "${artifacts[@]}"; do
    IFS=$'\t' read -r name url expected <<< "$artifact"
    [[ "$name" == "$(basename "$url")" ]]
    [[ "$url" == "${SOURCE_BASE}/${name}" ]]
    [[ "$expected" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
    public="$(pypi_digest "$name")"
    devzone="$(devzone_digest "$name")"

    if [[ "$public" == "$expected" && "$devzone" == "$expected" ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    if [[ -n "$public" && "$public" != "$expected" ]] || \
      [[ -n "$devzone" && "$devzone" != "$expected" ]]; then
      printf 'Published hash mismatch for %s.\n' "$name" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    if [[ -n "$public" || -n "$devzone" ]]; then
      if [[ "$allow_partial" == true ]]; then
        missing+=("$url")
        continue
      fi
      printf 'Partial Kitmaker publication detected for %s.\n' "$name" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    missing+=("$url")
  done
}

select_missing false
if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
  printf '%s is already published on both indexes.\n' "$project_name"
  exit 0
fi

payload='[]'
for url in "${missing[@]}"; do
  payload="$(
    jq -c \
      --arg pic "$pic" \
      --arg url "$url" \
      --argjson upload "$upload" '
        . + [{
          pic: $pic,
          job_type: "wheel-release-job",
          url: $url,
          upload: $upload,
          mirroring_strategy: "upload-both"
        }]
      ' <<< "$payload"
  )"
done
body="$(
  jq -cn --arg project_name "$project_name" --argjson payload "$payload" \
    '{project_name: $project_name, payload: $payload}'
)"

response="$tmp_dir/response"
curl_status=0
portal_request POST "projects/${project_id}/releases" "$response" "$body" || \
  curl_status=$?
http_code="$portal_http_code"
if [[ "$curl_status" -ne 0 || "$http_code" != 202 ]]; then
  printf 'Kitmaker submission failed (curl %s, HTTP %s).\n' \
    "$curl_status" "$http_code" >&2
  cat "$response" >&2
  exit 1
fi
release_uuid="$(jq -er '.release_uuid | strings | select(length > 0)' "$response")"

completed=false
for _ in {1..180}; do
  curl_status=0
  portal_request GET "status/${release_uuid}" "$response" || curl_status=$?
  http_code="$portal_http_code"

  if [[ "$curl_status" -ne 0 || "$http_code" == 429 || "$http_code" =~ ^5[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
    sleep 30
    continue
  fi
  if [[ "$http_code" != 200 ]]; then
    printf 'Kitmaker status failed (HTTP %s).\n' "$http_code" >&2
    cat "$response" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  status="$(jq -er '.status | strings | select(length > 0)' "$response")"
  printf 'Kitmaker %s status: %s\n' "$project_name" "$status"
  case "$status" in
    completed)
      completed=true
      break
      ;;
    failed)
      cat "$response" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
    *)
      sleep 30
      ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$completed" == true ]]

if [[ "$upload" == true ]]; then
  published=false
  for _ in {1..24}; do
    select_missing true
    if [[ "${#missing[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
      published=true
      break
    fi
    sleep 30
  done

#
# GitHub runners cannot reach Artifactory or the nSpect v2 API, so a maintainer
# runs this on the NVIDIA network between the Prepare Release and Publish Release
# workflows:
#
#   ci/stage_release.sh stage vX.Y.Z  upload the bundle to Artifactory and
#                                     register it with nSpect
#   ci/stage_release.sh check vX.Y.Z  evaluate nSpect launch readiness and, on
#                                     pass, set the nspect/launch commit status

# Requires an authenticated gh, curl, jq, and sha256sum. Both commands read
# NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID and NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET; stage also reads
# ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN, which must be able to deploy to sw-cuspa-generic-local.
# Other settings come from the repository's GitHub variables, as in the workflows.

set -Eeuo pipefail
trap '((BASH_SUBSHELL)) || printf "%s: line %s failed: %s\n" "$0" "$LINENO" "$BASH_COMMAND" >&2' ERR

repository=NVIDIA/cuspa
nspect_api=https://nspect.nvidia.com/api/v2

usage() {
  printf 'usage: %s stage|check vX.Y.Z[rcN]\n' "$0" >&2
  exit 2
}

# curl reads credentials from private config files so they stay out of argv.
auth_config() {
  (umask 077 && printf 'header = "%s"\n' "$2" > "$1")
}

repo_variable() {
  gh api "repos/${repository}/actions/variables/$1" --jq .value
}

staging_variable() {
  gh api "repos/${repository}/environments/release-staging/variables/$1" --jq .value
}

show_response() {
  jq . "$response" >&2 2> /dev/null || cat "$response" >&2
}

expect_status() {
  local got="$1"
  shift
  local want
  for want in "$@"; do
    [[ "$got" == "$want" ]] && return 0
  done
  printf 'nSpect returned HTTP %s.\n' "$got" >&2
  show_response
  return 1
}

# nspect METHOD PATH [BODY [CONTENT_TYPE]]: response body goes to $response,
# the HTTP status to stdout.
nspect() {
  local -a args=(
    --config "$nspect_auth" --silent --show-error
    --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120
    -X "$1" -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}'
  )
  if [[ -n "${3:-}" ]]; then
    args+=(-H "Content-Type: ${4:-application/json}" --data "$3")
  fi
  curl "${args[@]}" "${nspect_api}$2"
}

retry_after_seconds() {
  local seconds
  seconds="$(
    awk 'tolower($1) == "retry-after:" {gsub("\\r", "", $2); print $2}' "$1"
  )"
  if [[ ! "$seconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || ((seconds > 60)); then
    printf 'nSpect rate-limited the request with Retry-After %s.\n' "$seconds" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  printf '%s' "$seconds"
}

load_release() {
  local on_main
  local run_id

  artifactory_url="$(repo_variable ARTIFACTORY_URL)"
  artifactory_url="${artifactory_url%/}"
  artifactory_repository="$(repo_variable ARTIFACTORY_REPOSITORY)"
  nspect_id="$(staging_variable NSPECT_ID)"
  [[ "$artifactory_url" == https://artifactory.nvidia.com ]]
  [[ "$artifactory_repository" == sw-cuspa-generic-local ]]
  [[ "$nspect_id" =~ ^NSPECT-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ ]]
  if [[ "$version" == *rc* ]]; then
    release_type="$(staging_variable NSPECT_PRERELEASE_TYPE)"
  else
    release_type="$(staging_variable NSPECT_FINAL_TYPE)"
  fi
  [[ -n "$release_type" ]]

  sha="$(gh api "repos/${repository}/commits/${tag}" --jq .sha)"
  [[ "$sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
  on_main="$(gh api "repos/${repository}/compare/${sha}...main" --jq .status)"
  [[ "$on_main" == ahead || "$on_main" == identical ]]
  source_base="${artifactory_url}/artifactory/${artifactory_repository}/cuspa/nspect/${nspect_id}/${tag}/${sha}"

  run_id="$(
    gh run list --repo "$repository" --workflow release.yml --event push \
      --branch "$tag" --status success --limit 20 --json databaseId,headSha |

  )"

    printf 'No successful Prepare Release run for %s at %s.\n' "$tag" "$sha" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

    --name "cuspa-release-${tag}" --dir "$bundle"
  verify_bundle
  printf 'Verified the bundle from Prepare Release run %s (manifest %s).\n' \
    "$run_id" "${manifest_digest:0:12}"
}

verify_bundle() {
  local expected_sums="${work}/SHA256SUMS"
  local name
  local size
  local digest
  local pointer

  jq -e \
    --arg repository "$repository" \
    --arg tag "$tag" \
    --arg version "$version" \
    --arg commit "$sha" '
      .schemaVersion == 1 and
      .repository == $repository and
      .tag == $tag and
      .version == $version and
      .commit == $commit and
      (.artifacts | length) == 5 and
      ([.artifacts[].name] | unique | length) == 5
    ' "$manifest" > /dev/null

  : > "$expected_sums"
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name size digest pointer; do
    [[ "$name" == "$(basename "$name")" ]]
    [[ "$name" =~ ^cuspa(_cu(12|13))?-[A-Za-z0-9.+]+.*(\.whl|\.tar\.gz)$ ]]
    [[ "$pointer" == "${source_base}/${name}" ]]
    [[ "$(stat -c %s "${bundle}/${name}")" == "$size" ]]
    [[ "$(sha256sum "${bundle}/${name}" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$digest" ]]
    printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" >> "$expected_sums"
  done < <(
    jq -r '.artifacts[] | [.name, .size, .sha256, .sourcePointer] | @tsv' \
      "$manifest"
  )
  cmp -s "$expected_sums" "${bundle}/SHA256SUMS"
  [[ "$(find "$bundle" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 7 ]]
  manifest_digest="$(sha256sum "$manifest" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
}

stage_artifactory() {
  local artifactory_auth="${work}/artifactory.curlrc"
  local -a files
  local file
  local name
  local digest
  local size
  local url
  local remote
  local status

  auth_config "$artifactory_auth" "Authorization: Bearer ${ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN}"
  mapfile -t files < <(
    find "$bundle" -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name manifest.json -print | sort
  )
  files+=("$manifest")
  [[ "${#files[@]}" -eq 7 ]]
  for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    name="$(basename "$file")"
    digest="$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
    size="$(stat -c %s "$file")"
    url="${source_base}/${name}"
    remote="${work}/remote-${name}"

    status="$(
      curl --config "$artifactory_auth" --silent --show-error --location \
        --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
        --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
        -o "$remote" -w '%{http_code}' "$url"
    )"
    case "$status" in
      200)
        printf 'Already staged: %s\n' "$name"
        ;;
      404)
        curl --config "$artifactory_auth" --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
          --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
          --max-time 900 --proto '=https' \
          -H "X-Checksum-Sha256: ${digest}" \
          --upload-file "$file" "$url" > /dev/null
        printf 'Uploaded: %s\n' "$name"
        ;;
      *)
        printf 'Artifactory returned HTTP %s for %s.\n' "$status" "$url" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac

    curl --config "$artifactory_auth" --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
      --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 \
      --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
      -o "$remote" "$url"
    if [[ "$(stat -c %s "$remote")" != "$size" ]] ||
      [[ "$(sha256sum "$remote" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" != "$digest" ]]; then
      printf 'The staged %s does not match the bundle.\n' "$url" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done
}

nspect_login() {
  local ssa_auth="${work}/ssa.curlrc"
  local basic
  local token

  basic="$(
    printf '%s:%s' "$NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_ID" "$NSPECT_SSA_CLIENT_SECRET" |
      base64 -w 0
  )"
  auth_config "$ssa_auth" "Authorization: Basic ${basic}"
  token="$(
    curl --config "$ssa_auth" --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
      --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
      --data-urlencode grant_type=client_credentials \
      --data-urlencode 'scope=public.api:read public.api:write' \
      "$ssa_token_url" |
      jq -er '.access_token | strings | select(length > 0)'
  )"
  auth_config "$nspect_auth" "Authorization: Bearer ${token}"
}

wait_for_job() {
  local job_url="https://nspect.nvidia.com$1"
  local headers="${work}/headers"
  local attempt
  local status
  local delay

  for attempt in {1..180}; do
    status="$(
      curl --config "$nspect_auth" --silent --show-error \
        --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 -D "$headers" \
        -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' "$job_url"
    )"
    case "$status" in
      200)
        case "$(jq -er '.data.job.status' "$response")" in
          SUCCESS)
            return 0
            ;;
          PENDING | STARTED | PROCESSING | RETRY | PROGRESS)
            sleep 10
            ;;
          *)
            show_response
            return 1
            ;;
        esac
        ;;
      429)
        delay="$(retry_after_seconds "$headers")"
        sleep "$delay"
        ;;
      502 | 503 | 504)
        sleep "$((attempt < 6 ? attempt * 5 : 30))"
        ;;
      *)
        expect_status "$status" 200
        ;;
    esac
  done
  printf 'nSpect job %s did not finish.\n' "$1" >&2
  return 1
}

register_nspect() {
  local release="/public/programs/${nspect_id}/releases/${tag}"
  local owner_email
  local owner_name
  local release_date
  local status
  local body
  local patch
  local registration
  local job_uri

  owner_email="$(staging_variable NSPECT_RELEASE_OWNER_EMAIL)"
  owner_name="$(staging_variable NSPECT_RELEASE_OWNER_NAME 2> /dev/null)" ||
    owner_name=""
  release_date="$(gh api "repos/${repository}/commits/${sha}" --jq .commit.committer.date)"
  release_date="${release_date:0:10}"
  [[ "$release_date" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]

  status="$(nspect GET "$release")"
  if [[ "$status" == 404 ]]; then
    body="$(
      jq -nc \
        --arg name "$tag" \
        --arg description "Cuspa ${tag}" \
        --arg date "$release_date" \
        --arg email "$owner_email" \
        --arg owner "$owner_name" \
        '{name: $name, description: $description, releaseDate: $date, owner: ({email: $email} + (if $owner == "" then {} else {name: $owner} end)), labels: ["github-release"]}'
    )"
    status="$(nspect POST "/public/programs/${nspect_id}/releases" "$body")"
    if [[ "$status" == 409 ]]; then
      status="$(nspect GET "$release")"
      expect_status "$status" 200
    else
      expect_status "$status" 201
    fi
  else
    expect_status "$status" 200
  fi
  jq -e --arg name "$tag" \
    '.success == true and .data.release.name == $name' "$response" > /dev/null
  patch="$(
    jq -c '
      {
        deploymentTypes: {isDownloadable: true},
        releaseLocations: (
          ([.data.release.releaseLocations[]?.name] + ["GitHub"]) | unique
        )
      }
    ' "$response"
  )"

  status="$(nspect GET "${release}/release-types?pageSize=1000")"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e '
    [.data.releaseTypes[] | select(.regulation != null)] | length == 0
  ' "$response" > /dev/null

  status="$(nspect GET "/public/release-types?pageSize=1000")"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e --arg type "$release_type" '
    .page.total <= 1000 and
    ([.data.releaseTypes[] |
      select(.name == $type and .regulation == null)] | length) == 1
  ' "$response" > /dev/null

  body="$(jq -nc --arg type "$release_type" '{releaseTypes: [{releaseType: $type}]}')"
  status="$(nspect PUT "${release}/release-types" "$body")"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e '.success == true' "$response" > /dev/null

  status="$(nspect PATCH "$release" "$patch" application/merge-patch+json)"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e '
    .success == true and
    .data.release.deploymentTypes.isDownloadable == true and
    ([.data.release.releaseLocations[].name] | index("GitHub")) != null
  ' "$response" > /dev/null

  status="$(nspect GET "${release}/binary-artifacts?pageSize=1000")"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e --slurpfile manifest "$manifest" '
    ($manifest[0].artifacts | map(.sourcePointer)) as $expected |
    (.page.total <= 1000) and
    ([.data.binaryArtifacts[] |
      select(.sourcePointer as $url | ($expected | index($url)) == null)] |
      length == 0) and
    ([.data.binaryArtifacts[] as $artifact |
      select(($expected | index($artifact.sourcePointer)) != null) |
      select($artifact.includedInRelease != true)] | length == 0)
  ' "$response" > /dev/null

  registration="$(
    jq -n \
      --slurpfile manifest "$manifest" \
      --slurpfile current "$response" '
        ($current[0].data.binaryArtifacts | map(.sourcePointer)) as $existing |
        {binaryArtifacts: [
          $manifest[0].artifacts[] |

          {sourcePointer: .sourcePointer, includedInRelease: true}
        ]}
      '
  )"
  if [[ "$(jq '.binaryArtifacts | length' <<< "$registration")" -gt 0 ]]; then
    status="$(nspect POST "${release}/binary-artifacts" "$registration")"
    expect_status "$status" 202
    jq -e '
      .success == true and

    wait_for_job "$job_uri"
  fi

  status="$(nspect GET "${release}/binary-artifacts?pageSize=1000")"
  expect_status "$status" 200
  jq -e --slurpfile manifest "$manifest" '
    ($manifest[0].artifacts | map(.sourcePointer) | sort) as $expected |
    ([.data.binaryArtifacts[].sourcePointer] | sort) == $expected and
    ([.data.binaryArtifacts[] | select(.includedInRelease != true)] |
